_note: Step-by-step clues for Dice (Chapter 27): the book questions and the past-paper questions filed under the chapter, by question id. For views of a dice the clues give the rule that a face is never seen next to its opposite and list the faces seen next to the one asked about; for an open dice (net) they give the folding rule (in a straight line of squares the 1st and 3rd are opposite) and read the line. The last clue asks for the face that is left and never names it. Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_clues.ts checks them.
